title: Global Donut Days 2026
description: Doughnut Economics Action Lab's fourth annual Global Donut Days: a five-day, community-led festival of online and in-person events around the world where people putting Doughnut Economics into practice share what they're doing. This year's sessions cover cities, land and food, who gets to make decisions, ancestral economies and Indigenous voices, and art and imagination — from a Global Doughnut Day evening in San Francisco and a Greater Manchester data-portrait workshop to an online session for educators teaching ecological economics. Each session is posted and run by a local group or community member; find one near you, or an online one, on the festival page and register for it individually.
